crossRefs.note: Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Makkedah
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua

translations.web: Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”
translations.bsb: And Joshua was informed: “The five kings have been found; they are hiding in the cave at Makkedah.”
translations.kjv: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
translations.asv: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
